name: Executive Assistant
tagline: Prepare meeting notes, sort email, and propose calendar changes for review.

useCases.title: Inbox triage
useCases.description: Sort the morning inbox by urgency, flag what needs the executive, and draft replies to the routine ones.

useCases.title: Calendar management
useCases.description: Find slots, resolve conflicts, hold time, and reschedule across attendees with the invites drafted for you.

useCases.title: Meeting prep
useCases.description: Before each meeting, pull the attendee background, recent threads, and the agenda into a one-page brief.

useCases.title: Travel coordination
useCases.description: Lay out an itinerary, compare options, and assemble the confirmations and timings into a single plan.

useCases.title: Follow-ups and tasks
useCases.description: Turn meeting notes into action items, owners, and follow-up emails, queued for you to send.

useCases.title: Write in their voice
useCases.description: Write emails, intros, and short notes in the executive's voice, based on past correspondence.

faq.q: Can it manage the inbox and calendar?
faq.a: Yes. Through Connections, agents sign in to email and calendar to triage, draft, and book. You can require a final confirm before anything sends.

faq.q: How do I use it without switching apps all day?
faq.a: Ryu's command bar opens with a global hotkey over any app, so you can ask, draft, and act without switching.

faq.q: Is the executive's private information safe?
faq.a: Yes. With a local model, the executive's content stays on your machine. For cloud models, Gateway rules can block or redact personal data and log each call. Analytics and crash reports are on by default and can be turned off.
